mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market boosts productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in INDPRO, indicating supply chain resilience, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers' confidence grows.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during supply chain expansion periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $550B, indicating strong retail sales, consumer discretionary spending boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% and CPIAUCSL growth decelerates (< 2%), a dovish monetary stance with muted inflation expectations leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A single-month increase in UNRATE above 4.5%, signaling labor market softening, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors reassess growth prospects.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1.4M units, indicating a strong housing market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days, as broader economic growth is signaled.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher during strong housing market periods (t-test p > 0.05).
